koloyaaa-foreign-academic-translator-ski.description: Build and inspect an editable DOCX from the suite's canonical translated Markdown; use only when DOCX is selected.
Build and inspect the HTML reader from the suite's canonical translated Markdown; use only when HTML is selected.
Translate a foreign-language academic handout into faithful Chinese study material in the suite's canonical Markdown; use after the orchestrator confirms the source and options.
Extract, render, and visually review PDF lesson pages before translation, especially when pages contain scans, figures, or little selectable text.
Extract and visually inspect PowerPoint lesson slides into a page-indexed source handoff; use only for .pptx inputs before translation.
Audit translated lesson content against its complete source for omissions, additions, and meaning drift; use when requested or when a semantic-audit checkpoint cannot be reused.
Independently audit a Plus tier translation against its complete source and selected deliverables; report coverage, discrepancies, and limits without editing the translation.
Translate short, low-complexity DOCX or TXT handouts in one pass when selected by translation-orchestrator; use the shared quality audit and publisher checks.
Draft source-grounded multiple-choice questions for selected lesson difficulty levels; use only when the task manifest requests an end-of-chapter quiz.
Verify proposed quiz answers and write source-grounded explanations for a quiz draft; use after the quiz generator and only when a quiz was selected.
Translate short, manageable foreign-language academic handouts with the legacy workflow and a lightweight output readability check.
Translate foreign-language academic handouts with the legacy workflow, then require an independent full-source audit before reporting Plus completion.
Explain information-rich figures, diagrams, and image-only pages in a PDF or PowerPoint lesson; use only for pages flagged by the matching Reader.

Coordinate foreign academic handout workflows, choose the quick or full translation route, resolve settings, route only required reading, quiz, publishing, and audit Skills, and deliver selected files.
